children: German power company RWE has signed power agreements with the United Arab Emirates to increase cooperation in offshore wind auctions and explore long-term LNG deliveries to Germany and the rest of Europe.

RWE said Friday that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Masdar, the Abu Dhabi government's clean energy company, to consider joint participation in German offshore wind auctions in 2027. The agreement could result in more than 3 billion euros of investments, equivalent to $3.48 billion.

Separately, RWE and the country's state oil company Adnoc signed a letter of intent to increase long-term LNG supply opportunities into Germany and the rest of Europe. The parties intend to agree on the terms of up to two LNG sale and purchase agreements, RWE said.
